source: issue #1606 (Mountebank httpRequest.js:18: headersMap.ofRaw(request.rawHeaders) keeps the client's header order, a repeated name at its first position). Only the x- names are compared, lower-cased since Rift Title-Cases request names (docs/mountebank/differences.md), so the client's own headers do not matter; and only names, since a repeated header's value is an array in Mountebank and its first value in Rift's single-value script view. The body is not JSON, so the harness compares it byte for byte.

cases.name: header order: an inject sees request headers in the order the client sent them

responses.inject: function (config) { var names = Object.keys(config.request.headers).map(function (k) { return k.toLowerCase(); }); return { statusCode: 200, body: 'H ' + JSON.stringify(names.filter(function (k) { return k.indexOf('x-') === 0; })) }; }
